name: Performance Automotive
hook: Your customers in Willoughby bring you the daily driver and the lifted Jeep — your own photos show both, and a page on your own domain could put them in front of everyone searching for an alignment or a lift kit. We built a trial version. Take a look:
fakt: you've been running Performance Automotive as a family-owned shop on Apollo Parkway since 2010, from oil changes and wheel alignments to lift kits, cam upgrades and window tinting, you're an authorized Rough Country dealer and you post reels from the bays
na_stronie: your name and phone, six of your own photos (the Challenger under the hood, the alignment rack, the engine out on the lift, the Mustang, the lifted Jeep, the shop floor), eight services in your own words across routine service, repairs and performance (oil change and filters, wheel alignments, brake pads and rotors, suspension, engine repair, heating and cooling, lift kits, window tinting), online booking Monday to Thursday from 9 am and a contact form — every request lands straight in your inbox
dlaczego: Your reels already do the marketing; what's missing is a page they can land on, with your bays, your three service lines and online booking, so the alignment promo turns into appointments while you're under a car.
